name: jev-memory-timeouts-to-zero-2026-10-01 R-5 live measurement: memory-injection timeouts below 1% over at least 1,000 new-build calls, each residue attributed
command: SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome <> 'answered') AS not_answered, count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome <> 'answered' AND inconclusive_reason = 'timeout') AS timeouts, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome <> 'answered') / nullif(count(*),0), 2) AS pct, max(created_at), now() FROM harness_shared.decision_model_calls WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND consumer='memory-injection' AND surface IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= '2026-10-02T04:13:10Z'
residueCommand: SELECT created_at, surface, inconclusive_reason, loop_utilization, latency_ms, transport_latency_ms FROM harness_shared.decision_model_calls WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND consumer='memory-injection' AND surface IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= '2026-10-02T04:13:10Z' AND outcome <> 'answered' ORDER BY created_at
population: harness_shared.decision_model_calls rows for workspace papercusp-workspace, consumer memory-injection, surface IS NOT NULL (written only by builds carrying this plan's P-007 and P-008 changes: :3170 staging and bg-host), created at or after 2026-10-02T04:13:10Z. The embed-sidecar outage 04:29:54Z-04:53Z produced zero calls.

residue.cause: calling thread saturated (ELU 1.0); 60 s after the bg-host restart at 05:43:01Z and 17 s after the :3170 restart at 05:43:44Z
calling thread saturated (ELU 0.99) in the post-restart window
calling thread saturated (ELU 1.0) in the post-restart window
calling thread busy (ELU 0.84) in the post-restart window; box load average 109-131 on 128 cores

knownGap: Worker-transport timeouts do not record worker-side timing (transport_latency_ms is NULL on every residue), so the split between a slow Jev answer and a starved worker is not measured. Follow-up WI-10005319.
comparison: The old :3070 build f52b2457ba (no P-007/P-008) was ~25-27% not answered over the same window.
summary: 6 of 1,147 new-build memory-injection calls not answered (0.52%, below the 1% target over more than 1,000 calls); all 6 are timeouts and each carries its calling-thread event-loop utilization (0.84-1.0) as the named cause.

assertions.evidence: 6 of 6 not-answered rows are timeouts carrying calling-thread loop_utilization 0.84-1.0 (see residue[])
